model_quality_status: Too early: first VAL after only one update is initialization baseline; need fixed-panel trends after warmup.
eta_scope: This 10000-update ego phase only; includes future DDIM monitoring and saving; excludes exo adaptation/final paper evaluation.
eta_method: remaining updates times measured short-segment mean plus ten future 24-case validations and 12 extra scene-OFF cases at each of 5000/10000; first 36-case validation+save as rough per-case estimate.
timing_caveat: Small panel, two repeats per candidate and four baseline repeats, concurrent GPU training; not statistically stable full-model performance.
decision: Keep current sealed training configuration/runtime. Larger chunks and four KD-tree workers have scene-dependent, modest/noisy benefits; not sufficient evidence to invalidate support caches or restart the run.
